adversary.case: false landing: the thief (one device of three) lands an eviction of the owner's device; the owner's two devices objected and the landing leaves them unnamed
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: false landing, stated falsely: the same landing naming the objections
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: false landing, early: the thief lands before its own window has run
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: withheld row: the target used its device in the window (a row that is no objection) and a relay kept it from everyone until after the landing
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: the owner is away the whole window and signs nothing; the thief lands
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: objection signed just after, naming the landing: the owner returns and objects honestly
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: objection signed just after, leaving the landing unnamed: the owner returns and objects with both devices
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: a second landing naming both: after the thief's landing, the owner's second device lands 'refused', naming the landing and the objections
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: lost device: the owner holds one of three and evicts a lost device, which signs nothing
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: silent stolen device: the same eviction; the target is held by a thief who signs a row after the landing and leaves it unnamed
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: quorum: the owner's two devices evict the stolen one at once; the thief objects, concurrent with the landing
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: the count with no landing: the owner's two devices approve the eviction of the stolen one and nobody lands
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: the others refuse with no landing: the thief proposes and the owner's two devices object
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: one approval short of the count, no landing: nothing has changed
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: the proposer withdraws its open proposal
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: a withdrawal beside a majority's approval, neither naming the other
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: an approval that names the withdrawal
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: a withdrawal in the lone landing's past: the landing states 'landed' over it
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: a withdrawal concurrent with the lone landing
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: a withdrawal that names the lone landing: it came after
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: another key signs a withdrawal of the proposal
adversary.window: self roster, lone eviction (24 h, target silent)

adversary.case: the count with no landing: two of three approve the new key
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: a proposal alone: the key of an addition is not seated while the window is open
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: the lone path: nobody answers in 24 h and the proposer lands
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: false landing, early: the thief lands its own key before its window has run
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: the others refuse: the thief proposes its own key and the owner's two devices object, no landing
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: false landing: the thief lands its key at the close, leaving the two objections unnamed
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: one objection of two others is not a refusal: the thief lands at the close over it
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: the key being added signs rows in the window: an addition has no target's silence
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: the proposer withdraws the addition
adversary.window: self roster, lone addition (24 h)

adversary.case: false landing: a member lands the members' moderation; the moderator had answered and the landing leaves the answer unnamed
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: false landing, stated falsely: the same landing naming the moderator's answer
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: false landing, no count: one member lands the fallback alone
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: withheld answer: an honest member lands; a relay had kept the moderator's answer from the room
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: a second landing naming both: another member lands 'answered', naming the first landing and the moderator's answer
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: absent moderator: nobody answers in 48 h and the members' majority acts
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: answer signed just after, naming the landing: the moderator returns and answers honestly
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: answer signed just after, leaving the landing unnamed: the moderator returns late
adversary.window: moderation fallback (48 h, absent moderator, members' majority)

adversary.case: false landing: the halting holder lands 'confirmed' with no other voice
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: the lone halt lapses: nobody confirms; another holder lands the lapse at the fuse
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: objection signed just after, unnamed: the lapse lands; the halting holder signs a further confirm and leaves the landing unnamed
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: false landing: a holder lands 'lapsed' on a halt a strict majority confirmed, leaving the confirm unnamed
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: withheld confirm: an honest holder lands the lapse; a relay had kept the confirming voice from it
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: a second landing naming both: the confirming holder lands 'confirmed', naming the false lapse and its own confirm
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: confirm signed just after, naming the landing: a second holder confirms honestly after the lapse
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: confirm signed just after, unnamed: a second holder confirms after the lapse and leaves the landing unnamed
adversary.window: halt fuse (24 h, lapses unless a strict majority confirms)

adversary.case: false landing, no count: one member objects and lands the lift alone
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: the room lifts: two of three object and one of them lands at once
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: stands at the close: one objection in 48 h and another member lands
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: false landing: a member lands 'stands' leaving a second objection unnamed
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: withheld objection: an honest member lands 'stands'; a relay had kept the second objection from it
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: a second landing naming both: a member lands 'lifted', naming the first landing and the second objection
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: the duty holder objects to its own act, with one member: the landing names both
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: a key with no seat at the head objects, with one member
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: the floor: in a room of one, the one member objects and lands
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: objection signed just after, naming the landing: a member objects late and honestly
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)

adversary.case: objection signed just after, leaving the landing unnamed
adversary.window: moderation overturn (48 h, the members' check on a duty holder's act)
